model: e141-lgbm-3round-1.0 (LGBM-AUTO, trained on 203 measured HFIAS rows)
validation_status: CANDIDATE - E141 forecast gate not passed; validation pending; not a released forecast
claim: Estimated relative risk for the display quarter: P(the province's HFIAS moderate-or-severe food insecurity is above the national level), from information public before the issue date. Evidence (E141): on the untouched 2013 round the model ranks provinces well (AUC 0.94) but is under-calibrated (ECE 0.14); forecasting the next measured round (three survey-to-survey origins) it is not significantly better than the previous survey or the region's previous level. Quarter-to-quarter change is NOT validated: no quarterly provincial measurement exists.
explanation_method: exact TreeSHAP (sums with the base value to the predicted relative logit)
interval_note: model-refit uncertainty (16-region bootstrap, 200 refits); excludes survey sampling error and temporal change, so it understates the total uncertainty
class_rule: HIGH if the whole 90 % interval is >= 0.5, LOW if it is < 0.5, otherwise UNCERTAIN
meaning: Estimated probability that the province's household food insecurity (HFIAS moderate-or-severe) is above the national level. A risk estimate: HIGH does not confirm food insecurity and LOW does not guarantee food security. It is not the share of food-insecure households.

explanations.sentence: Lower poverty levels mean fewer households are likely to lack the money for enough food.
Earlier food-security surveys found this area below the national level of food insecurity.
Provinces in this island group have tended to show lower measured food insecurity.
This factor did not noticeably change the estimate.
Recent weather and harvests have not added pressure on local food supply.

not_model_inputs.employment_remittances: no provincial series for the training years
not_model_inputs.utilization: no nutrition, water or sanitation data held
